findings.detail: Requested operations have unequal delivered task counts.
findings.remediation: Use the per-operation counts when comparing results; generate missing evidence before expanding weak categories.
Place disjoint canonical sections and facts in separate task input files; paraphrases, extra assertions, and format copies do not add units.
